raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #47205

## Motivation

Reasoning detectors build `think_end_ids` by encoding the end marker's text, and `ReasonerGrammarObject` keeps a request's grammar off until the generated ids match that sequence. When the tokenizer does not parse special tokens out of text (`split_special_tokens=True`), a special added marker such as gpt-oss's `<|end|>` encodes to ordinary ids the model never generates. The gate never opens, so `require_reasoning` requests (structured output, forced tool calls) run without their grammar and nothing reports it. Resolving the marker by id in the shared detector path fixes this for every detector instead of one override at a time.

## Effect

`get_think_end_token_ids` with `split_special_tokens=True`:

| Model | Marker | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| gpt-oss-20b | `<\|end\|>` | `[27, 91, 419, 91, 29]` | `[200007]` |
| gpt-oss-120b | `<\|end\|>` | `[27, 91, 419, 91, 29]` | `[200007]` |

Default loading is unchanged, and so are markers that are added tokens not marked special.

## Modifications

- New `marker_token_ids` helper resolves a single special or added-token marker by id.
- Other markers, including unknown ones, keep text encoding.
- Base and response-template reasoning detectors use the helper.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: tokenizers that parse special tokens from text get the same ids as before.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the ids are computed once at scheduler start-up.

## Test Plan

- New regression cases in the reasoning-parser unit tests fail on `main` and pass here.
- CPU check with the real gpt-oss-20b and gpt-oss-120b tokenizers gives the table above.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

+"""Token ids of framing markers that the model emits, such as reasoning end tags."""
+
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerBase
+
+
+def marker_token_ids(*, tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerBase, marker: str) -> List[int]:
+    # A tokenizer that does not parse special tokens out of text, for example one
+    # loaded with split_special_tokens=True, encodes a special marker's printed
+    # name as ordinary tokens the model never emits.
+    token_id = _single_token_id(tokenizer=tokenizer, marker=marker)
+    if token_id is not None:
+        return [token_id]
+    return tokenizer.encode(marker, add_special_tokens=False)
+
+
+def _single_token_id(
+    *, tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizerBase, marker: str
+) -> Optional[int]:
+    try:
+        token_id = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(marker)
+    except Exception:
+        # A tokenizer that cannot look the marker up keeps the text-encoding path.
+        return None
+    if token_id in tokenizer.all_special_ids:
+        # An unknown marker maps to the unknown token, which is itself special.
+        return token_id if tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(token_id) == marker else None
+    # Added tokens marked special are split too, but are not all in all_special_ids.
+    return token_id if tokenizer.get_added_vocab().get(marker) == token_id else None

         )
 
 
+class _SplitSpecialTokenizer:
+    """Never parses special tokens out of text, as with split_special_tokens=True."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, added_vocab: dict[str, int], special_ids: dict[str, int]):
+        self._added_vocab = added_vocab
+        self._ids = {**added_vocab, **special_ids, "<unk>": 0}
+        self.all_special_ids = [0, *special_ids.values()]
+
+    def encode(self, text, add_special_tokens):
+        return [100 + ord(char) for char in text]
+
+    def convert_tokens_to_ids(self, token):
+        return self._ids.get(token, 0)
+
+    def convert_ids_to_tokens(self, token_id):
+        return {v: k for k, v in self._ids.items()}[token_id]
+
+    def get_added_vocab(self):
+        return self._added_vocab
+
+
+class TestThinkEndTokenIds(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_added_end_marker_maps_to_its_id(self):
+        """The reasoning gate matches generated ids, so an end marker that is an added
+        token must map to the one id the model emits, even when its text splits."""
+        tokenizer = _SplitSpecialTokenizer(added_vocab={"</think>": 7}, special_ids={})
+        self.assertEqual(Qwen3Detector().get_think_end_token_ids(tokenizer), [7])
+
+    def test_special_end_marker_without_added_vocab_maps_to_its_id(self):
+        tokenizer = _SplitSpecialTokenizer(added_vocab={}, special_ids={"</think>": 7})
+        self.assertEqual(Qwen3Detector().get_think_end_token_ids(tokenizer), [7])
+
+    def test_unknown_marker_is_encoded(self):
+        tokenizer = _SplitSpecialTokenizer(added_vocab={"</think>": 7}, special_ids={})
+        detector = BaseReasoningFormatDetector(
+            think_start_token="<think>", think_end_token="\n</think>"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            detector.get_think_end_token_ids(tokenizer),
+            [100 + ord(char) for char in "\n</think>"],
+        )
+
